description: Composite nine-panel figure on S5 steel after austempering at T_B = 335 °C and 365 °C, mixing SEM, XRD and EBSD. (a) SE-SEM of the 335 °C condition with white arrows labelling "Bainitic lamellae inside lenticular martensite"; an inset black bar reads 500 nm and the main scale bar 1 µm. (b) SEM of the 365 °C condition labelled "Impingement free structure", arrow to "Film-like-γr"; the inset (10 µm bar) shows a dark angular AlN particle and "αp on GBs"; main bar 1 µm. (c) XRD, Intensity (a.u.) vs 2θ = 41–46°, legend T_B: 335 °C (dash-dot) and T_B: 365 °C (solid), with (111)γ and (110)α peaks; no martensite reflection is resolvable. (d, e) IPF maps (10 µm and 5 µm bars) at 335 °C showing fine bainitic lath packets with lenticular regions labelled M (martensite); (f) IPF map (5 µm) at 365 °C with a region labelled F (allotriomorphic ferrite) and a 001/101/111 IPF colour triangle. (g, h, i) KAM maps printed "Average KAM value: 0.809 / 0.825 / 0.905" with colour scales 0–4.99°, 0–4.82°, 0–4.85°. Overall the group shows finer bainite with local KAM spikes at 335 °C versus slightly coarser bainite, trace F and marginally higher global KAM at 365 °C.

observations.observation: Panel (a) SEM of S5 at 335 °C contains the printed annotation "Bainitic lamellae inside lenticular martensite", with an inset 500 nm scale bar and a main 1 µm scale bar.
Panel (b) SEM of S5 at 365 °C is labelled "Impingement free structure" and an arrow points to "Film-like-γr" between bainite laths; the 10 µm inset image additionally labels "AlN" and "αp on GBs".
Panel (c) XRD spans 2θ = 41–46° with labelled reflections (111)γ and (110)α; the legend reads T_B: 335 °C (dash-dot) and T_B: 365 °C (solid), and the two patterns almost superimpose.

The (110)α reflection in panel (c) reaches about 2000 a.u. on the intensity axis while the (111)γ reflection reaches roughly 1100–1200 a.u.; no separate martensite reflection is resolvable in either pattern.
The caption states that the XRD pattern in (c) for T = 335 °C shows α + γr with no resolvable martensite.
The caption assigns (d, e, g, h) to 335 °C and (f, i) to 365 °C, describing (d–f) as EBSD IPF and (g–i) as KAM maps.
Panels (d) and (e) IPF maps label lenticular plates as "M" (martensite) inside narrow bainitic-ferrite lath packets; panel (f) IPF map labels a coarser region as "F" (allotriomorphic ferrite).
The printed average KAM values on the three KAM maps are 0.809 (g), 0.825 (h) and 0.905 (i), with colour scales of 0–4.99°, 0–4.82° and 0–4.85° respectively.

The citing text states mean KAM of ~0.905° (365 °C) vs 0.825° (335 °C) and median 0.789° vs 0.692°, but the printed map labels give 0.809 and 0.825 for the two 335 °C fields, so the pairing of the printed averages with the two conditions is not fully consistent between figure and text.
The citing text states that local KAM hot-spots in panel (h) occur adjacent to M and are attributed to a high density of geometrically necessary dislocations from low-temperature displacive growth.
The citing text states the KAM maps were acquired at different magnifications (25k× vs 20k×), so absolute KAM values are step-size sensitive.

The citing text reports XRD-derived quantities not printed on the figure: retained austenite 19 % at 335 °C vs ~26 % at 365 °C, with austenite/ferrite microstrains εγ 0.51 % and εα 0.45 % at 335 °C converging to 0.42 % and 0.43 % at 365 °C.

The citing text links the 335 °C microstructure to UTS 1530 MPa and elongation 7 %, and the 365 °C microstructure to UTS 1315 MPa and elongation 8.7 %; these mechanical values are not present in the figure itself.
All EBSD maps show numerous small white pixels and thin dark boundary lines, i.e. unindexed/low-confidence points and high-angle boundary networks within the bainitic structure.

subfigures.description: SE-SEM micrograph of S5 at T_B = 335 °C. Fine parallel bainitic lamellae/sheaf are wrapped inside larger martensite units; two white arrows are annotated "Bainitic lamellae inside lenticular martensite". A black inset carries a 500 nm scale bar and the panel has a 1 µm scale bar.

SE-SEM micrograph of S5 at T_B = 365 °C with lath/feathery bainite; arrow points to thin inter-lath "Film-like-γr" and the field is labelled "Impingement free structure". Main scale bar 1 µm. The top-left inset is a lower-magnification SE image (10 µm bar) with arrows marking a dark angular "AlN" particle and "αp on GBs" (proeutectoid ferrite on grain boundaries).

XRD pattern, x-axis 2θ = 41–46°, y-axis Intensity (a.u.) 0–2000; two nearly superimposed curves (dash-dot = T_B: 335 °C, solid = T_B: 365 °C). Two peaks are labelled (111)γ (near 43.1°, reaching roughly 1100–1200 a.u.) and (110)α (near 44.6°, reaching about 2000 a.u.); no martensite peak is visible.

EBSD inverse-pole-figure orientation map (10 µm scale bar) of the 335 °C condition: fine, differently coloured bainitic packets with intra-packet colour clustering and frequent high-angle boundaries; two lenticular regions are labelled "M" (martensite).
Higher-magnification IPF map (5 µm scale bar) of the martensite-focused field at 335 °C: large elongated magenta/blue lenticular plates labelled "M" embedded in finer lath packets.

IPF map (5 µm scale bar) of the 365 °C condition showing coarser bainitic packets with a blue-green region labelled "F" (allotriomorphic ferrite); an IPF colour key triangle is plotted with 001 at the top apex, 101 at bottom-left and 111 at bottom-right.

Kernel average misorientation (KAM) map with vertical label "Average KAM value: 0.809"; colour bar "Kernel Aver. Misorient. [°]" spanning 0 (blue) to 4.99 (red). Raised KAM appears as diffuse green/yellow speckle along lath and packet boundaries.
KAM map, "Average KAM value: 0.825", colour bar 0–4.82°: bands of elevated local misorientation along lath/packet boundaries with more pronounced local maxima (KAM hot-spots) in the field.
KAM map of the 365 °C condition, "Average KAM value: 0.905", colour bar 0–4.85°: fairly uniform, denser green/white misorientation speckle across the field without strongly localised hot-spots.

unreadable_items: panel (c): the small difference in the (111)γ peak height/intensity between the 335 °C and 365 °C curves cannot be reliably quantified from the rendering, so no austenite fraction can be read off the pattern
panels (d)–(f): IPF colour-to-orientation conversion (which sample direction the IPF is referenced to, IPF-Z or IPF-X) is not stated on the panels
panel (e): the number and exact outline of the 'M' (martensite) regions at the supplied resolution is only partly discernible
evidence block ids for the caption and citing sentences were not supplied in the request; placeholder ids (caption, citation_1, citation_2) are used
